steps.note: Configure the event with an RFP technical stage.
Open the RFP stage before configuring its template and questions.
Apply an available RFP template containing a question.
Populate the technical questionnaire so the template question is present.

args.goal: On the RFP questionnaire screen, click the Edit icon for the existing question, replace its question text with a new text, save the question, and stop on the questionnaire screen showing the updated text.

steps.note: Perform the question edit and save, which has no dedicated catalog action.
Confirm the edit and save completed without an application error.
